project.name: Trip Hop Dark Mainstream Hook-Heavy Arrangement

arrangement.notes: Arrangement follows a hook-heavy energy profile emphasizing dark mood with mainstream trip hop aesthetics using modern sample chopping techniques.

event_markers.label: Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Introduce hook with high energy drum chops

event_markers.label: Final Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Prominent hook vocal chops to emphasize climax

track_roles.drums: rhythmic foundation using sample chopping techniques
track_roles.bass: low-end support with chopped bass samples
track_roles.chords: background harmonic texture using sliced chords
track_roles.melody: hook melodies created by chopped melodic samples
track_roles.vocal: vocal chops processed with modern slicing and stuttering
track_roles.fx: effects layers emphasizing reversed and sliced samples

sensei_drum.brief: Create rhythmic patterns leveraging modern sample chopping techniques such as slicer, chopper, stutter, and slice rolls, focusing on dark trip hop style and hook emphasis.

bass_generator.brief: Generate bass lines using chopped and sliced bass samples, maintaining a supportive low-end groove reflective of trip hop style with moderate energy.

harmony_generator.brief: Produce chordal textures using modern sample slicing and chopping to build atmospheric dark harmonic layers that complement the bass and drums.

melody_generator.brief: Develop hook-heavy melodic elements by employing sample chopping, slicing, and stuttering techniques aligned to the dark mood and mainstream trip hop variation.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement flow ensuring energy curve matches hook-heavy profile and section dynamics support dark trip hop mood using modern sample chopping styles.

presetor.brief: Apply presets and effects tailored for chopped samples emphasizing stutter, slice rolls, and reversed samples to enhance dark trip hop arrangement.

songgps.brief: Guide structural layout following trip hop mainstream variation with emphasis on hook sections and energy balance throughout the 80 bars.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix parameters prioritizing clarity and separation of chopped sample layers, maintaining mood dark and energy hook-focused.
